reviewer_authority: Read-only reviewer-authored reports received from the operator; reviewer has no repository, GitHub, lifecycle, release, deployment, or remediation authority.

known_child_routes.routing_basis: operator routing update received after source-report intake
known_child_routes.scope_note: Issue-graph routing only; the PDF-derived source finding inventory remains unchanged.

findings.title: Send Gate unsatisfied: no dispatch, no exact head SHA, no recomputed corpus digest
findings.invariant: External documentation review findings must be bound to a dispatched exact revision and recomputed corpus digest.
findings.reproduction_or_proof_gap: The report states no dispatch accompanied the request, so the head SHA could not be confirmed and the corpus digest could not be recomputed.
findings.recommendation: Issue the dispatch naming PR, base, exact head SHA, and inventory SHA-256; reviewer checks out that SHA, recomputes the digest, runs the read-only commands, then reviews.

findings.title: Code-reduction claim is not supported by measurement at workspace level
findings.invariant: Codebase reduction claims must be supported by measured source evidence at the claimed scope.
findings.reproduction_or_proof_gap: The report measured adl/src across v0.91.7, v0.91.8, and v0.92 and found roughly -2 percent change plus retained large legacy files and additional crates.
findings.recommendation: Publish the measured before/after figure with path and method, or restate the claim as scoped to specific deleted surfaces; publish the per-subsystem boot-path table.

findings.title: Request framing conflicts with the milestone's own documented state
findings.invariant: External review framing must match the milestone checklist and quality-gate state.
findings.reproduction_or_proof_gap: The report contrasts the request framing with unchecked milestone checklist rows and quality-gate text saying the gate is a plan, not passed evidence.
findings.recommendation: Align external framing with the checklist: v0.92 engineering is complete, but documentation reconciliation, #467 gate hydration, external review, and ceremony remain open.

findings.title: Quality gate carries an unreconciled result-status ambiguity
findings.invariant: One quality-gate document must not imply conflicting entering results for downstream readers.
findings.reproduction_or_proof_gap: The report says QUALITY_GATE_v0.92.md simultaneously references a blocked result and #467 zero blockers/downstream unlock true.
findings.recommendation: State the single canonical entering result in one place with its owning issue, and mark the other passage as historical provenance.

findings.title: Post-commit cleanup failure reports an error for a succeeded activation
findings.invariant: After a durable activation commit, cleanup-residue failures should not make callers treat the activation as not committed.
findings.reproduction_or_proof_gap: The report identifies activate_owned returning DurableWrite when remove_file cleanup fails after fs::rename succeeds.
findings.recommendation: Introduce a distinct terminal variant for committed-with-cleanup-pending so callers can distinguish committed-and-untidy from not-committed.

findings.title: Integrity field defaults to empty string on serialization failure
findings.invariant: Integrity fields must not silently degrade to empty values on serialization failure.
findings.reproduction_or_proof_gap: The report cites receipt_from_input setting input_sha256 via canonical_sha256(input).unwrap_or_default().
findings.recommendation: Make receipt_from_input return Result<ProductionBirthdayReceipt, ProductionBirthdayError> and propagate serialization failure.

findings.title: Transaction lock is advisory and single-host assumption is undocumented
findings.invariant: The durability model must document or enforce its single-host local-filesystem assumption.
findings.reproduction_or_proof_gap: The report cites Ownership::acquire using fs2::FileExt::try_lock_exclusive on {resident}.lock.
findings.recommendation: Document the single-host local-filesystem assumption at ProductionBirthdayStore and reject known-network filesystems at open() or record the constraint in the deployment gate.
